verdict.rationale: Angular's own repository points developers to an official upgrade guide for the best way to upgrade a project (angular-gh-3). The CLI also ships `ng update` to update the workspace and its dependencies (angular-docs-15), so a dedicated first-party migration path exists. The community complaint that Angular 2 broke compatibility with Angular 1 (angular-comm-4) confirms that incompatible majors happen, but it does not contradict the guide's existence. missing for 10: evidence of the guide's version-to-version content (breaking-change lists, step-by-step instructions between specific majors), coverage of the AngularJS-to-Angular migration, independent or hands-on corroboration that the guide is usable.
